var OT_LOG = '[OptanonWrapper]';
var OT_DEBUG = false;
function otLog() { if (OT_DEBUG) console.debug.apply(console, arguments); }

var NON_ESSENTIAL = ['C0002', 'C0003', 'C0004'];
var otDeferredTimer = null;

// Called by OneTrust on every page load and every consent change.
function OptanonWrapper() {
  // On first run, capture the current consent state as a baseline.
  if (typeof OptanonWrapperCount === 'undefined') {
    OptanonWrapperCount = '';
    otIniGrps = OnetrustActiveGroups;
    otLog(OT_LOG, 'init', otIniGrps);

    // (returning visitor who rejected previously), delete leftover cookies
    // once per session so stale identifiers don't persist across visits.
    staleCookieCleanup();
    return;
  }

  // e.g. user had C0001,C0002,C0004 → now has C0001 → revoked = [C0002, C0004]

    .filter(function(id) { return curr.indexOf(id) === -1; });

  // groups are still denied at execution time so a quick reject → re-accept

// but is now denied. Runs at most once per browser session (sessionStorage flag).
function staleCookieCleanup() {

    if (sessionStorage.getItem('ot_cleanup_done')) return;
  } catch (e) { /* sessionStorage unavailable (privacy mode) — proceed with cleanup */ }

  var curr = OnetrustActiveGroups.split(',').filter(Boolean);

// Returns deleted count (>= 0) on success, or -1 if inventory was unavailable.
function deleteCookiesForGroups(groupIds, reason) {

  } catch (e) {
    otLog(OT_LOG, 'GetDomainData unavailable');
    return -1;

// which domain the cookie was originally set on.
function eraseCookie(name) {

    if (apex !== hostname) {
      domains.push(apex);
      domains.push('.' + apex);

    }
  }

We’re the leading customer engagement platform that’s passionate about helping brands forge lasting connections through engaging customer experiences. How Braze Works How it started... Forged from a unique series of events, Braze CEO Bill Magnuson and CTO Jon Hyman participated in a 2011 hackathon that led to a chance meeting with their third cofounder, Mark Ghermezian. They founded Braze (formerly Appboy) with the deeply held belief that the broad adoption of mobile would drive tremendous change in business and society—and it has. They developed an engagement platform to help the world’s best companies grow by trusting us with their most valuable asset: their customer relationships. ...how it’s going. After years of exponential growth and becoming a category-defining leader in customer engagement, Braze became a publicly traded company in November 2021 (Nasdaq: BRZE). In 2023, the company passed $500M in CARR and became a leader in Forrester Wave, Gartner Magic Quadrant, and IDC MarketScapes for cross-channel marketing. Today, Braze helps more than 2,000 of the world’s leading global brands across more than 70 countries to Be Absolutely Engaging.™ The new standard in customer engagement. We're committed to setting the bar high in customer engagement—through product, performance, strategic customer support, and thought leadership. 4.5T Messages and Other Canvas Actions in 2025 8.5B Monthly active users as of April 2026 10.2T API calls to Braze in 2025 15 Offices with 2,000 employees across 5 continents 2,700+ Global brands empowered by Braze to Be Absolutely Engaging™ MADE TO SCALE WITH COMPANIES OF ALL SIZES Social Impact at Braze At Braze, we know we have an opportunity to shape the future—to create a more equitable world, and a healthier planet for all. Our Social Impact team aims to amplify employee passions, invest in our communities, and accelerate science-based climate solutions. Community Opportunity Environment ESG Community Braze creates lasting value for and with our communities through Braze Cares (year-round volunteerism and giving initiatives), grant-making via the Braze for Social Impact Fund (pledging 1% of equity over ten years), and Tech for an Equitable Future (product grants). Product Grants Equity Braze supports a global and inclusion culture, where we design our processes and policies to be inclusive, monitor for gaps and identify opportunities where we can invest time and resources into shaping an equitable future for all. Learn More Environment We aim to accelerate science-based climate solutions to benefit the people and the planet. We measure our greenhouse gas emissions annually and are working to reduce our emissions, invest in renewable energy and make our offices and events more sustainable. Going Green ESG Braze is committed to advancing our environmental, social, and governance (ESG) initiatives. Since becoming a public company, we have published annual ESG reports in an effort to take our seat at the table and encourage responsible stewardship. Explore pricing and packaging options and get started with Braze

Flexible offerings designed for wherever you are in your customer engagement journey.

Get pricingStart a free trial

Platform Editions purpose-built for your stage

Whether you're sending your first campaign or orchestrating AI-powered engagement at global scale, Braze Platform Editions are designed for exactly where you are and built to grow with you.

Braze Go

For early-stage growth teams looking to activate customer data and launch personalized cross-channel messaging.

  • Core Braze features &  functionality

Braze Select

For companies scaling their engagement across more channels and team members while strengthening their governance and security.

  • Everything in Braze Go, plus:
  • Increased orchestration capabilities
  • Enhanced security features and user provisioning

Braze Pro

For brands optimizing performance and maximizing impact with advanced BrazeAI™ capabilities and personalization.

  • Everything in Braze Select, plus:
  • Predictive AI capabilities
  • AI personalized recommendations
  • Expanded dashboard user group administration

Braze Enterprise

For forward-thinking enterprises running engagement at massive scale.

  • Everything in Braze Pro, plus:
  • Enterprise-grade orchestration, infrastructure, and governance
  • Advanced experimentation with BrazeAI Agent Console™
Get pricing

Features included in every tier

BrazeAI™

  • BrazeAI Operator™
  • BrazeAI Agent Console™
  • Generative AI
  • Intelligence Suite
  • Personalized Paths &  Personalized Variant
  • Winning Path & Winning Variant

Braze Data Platform

  • Cloud Data Ingestion
  • Zero-copy segmentation & personalization
  • Custom Data & Catalogs
  • Data Transformation
  • Data export, reporting, & analytics

Cross-channel messaging

  • Email
  • Push Notifications
  • SMS, MMS, RCS
  • WhatsApp, KakaoTalk, LINE
  • In-App Messages, Banners, Content Cards
  • Landing Pages, Feature Flags
  • Audience Sync, Webhooks
  • Message Archiving

Journey orchestration

  • Campaigns & Canvases
  • Engagement testing & experimentation
  • Frequency capping & rate limiting
  • Templates & media management
  • Locations & geofences

Trust and infrastructure

  • Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
  • SAML & Single-Sign On (SSO)
  • Security settings & event logs
  • Granular permissions

Scale your investment with real user engagement

Pricing scales with your Monthly Active Users (MAU), the customers who actively interact with your brand across your digital experiences.

Build one unified customer profile

Unify customer data across devices, channels, and touchpoints to maintain a comprehensive customer profile without unnecessary duplication.

Maintain full customer visibility

Store a complete view of your audience in Braze while aligning spend to active users—so you get full context without paying for dormant profiles.

Activate engagement when it matters most

Choose when and where to start tracking users on your website or app. Capture meaningful customer activity aligned with your engagement strategy.

Fuel your reach with Action Credits

Optimize your strategy with a flexible credit-based model that works across every channel and certain BrazeAI™ products.

Unlock cross-product agility

Use credits across any combination of email, SMS, in-product messaging, BrazeAI Agent Console™ and more so you can focus your spend where it delivers the strongest results.

Move faster without friction

Launch exciting new channels and evolve your strategy at any time, all without additional commercial friction.

Experiment with less risk

Test and learn what works for your customer as they (and their needs) evolve. Adjust volumes based on performance to continually deliver strong ROI.

Tap into expertise at every step

Take advantage of our comprehensive support network designed to help brands like yours navigate the world of customer engagement with confidence.

Support where you need it, when you need it

Access technical expertise and troubleshooting to keep engagement running smoothly around the clock. From initial implementation to long-term strategy, Braze offers the resources and partnership necessary to unlock continuous value.

Experts dedicated to your goals

Partner with strategic advisors and technical architects who are equally focused on aligning the platform with specific business goals and growth milestones.

Join the community

Tap into the Braze Bonfire network and connect with more than 4,500 marketers to share ideas and insights on complex migrations, advanced strategy, and technical optimization.

acceptedAnswer.text: Braze supports companies at every stage of growth including startups launching their first engagement programs, to scaling companies meeting expansive growth, to large global enterprises looking for the leading customer engagement platform.

mainEntity.name: What will my contract with Braze look like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your Braze contract will be comprised of a Platform Edition tailored to your business needs, Monthly Active Users and Profiles, an allotment of Action Credits to power messaging and AI features, and CX Services to support your use of the platform. We also offer a variety of add-on SKUs across our Braze Data Platform and BrazeAITM product suite so you can customize your contract and unlock other valuable features within Braze.

mainEntity.name: What is a Monthly Active User? What is a Profile? Why are they important?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Monthly Active User (MAU) is any unique person who records a session on your Braze-connected app or website during a calendar month. You decide who counts: you can track every visitor if you value anonymous traffic, or limit tracking to only logged-in users. A Profile is the digital record of that person. It stores the user traits and behaviors that allow you to send truly personalized messages. Because your total user base is typically larger than your active monthly audience, every MAU in your plan includes a large allotment of User Profiles. This allows you to store data and re-engage customers with the right message, even if they haven't visited your app or website in a while.

mainEntity.name: What products and channels does Action Credits give me access to?

acceptedAnswer.text: Braze Action Credits unlock the flexible use of any of the following features throughout your contract: Email, SMS/MMS, RCS, WhatsApp, LINE, KakaoTalk, Content Cards, Banners, Message Archiving, Audience Sync, Webhooks, and BrazeAI Agent Console™. New and exciting features may be added to Action Credits in the future, giving you instant access to use them upon release.

Think of Action Credits as a single, flexible currency for your Braze account. Instead of purchasing fixed quantities for individual products, you buy one pool of credits as part of your contract. You can then use those credits across different channels and features based on your engagement strategy. Each action consumes a different number of credits—for example, sending an SMS may cost 1 credit, while a WhatsApp message may cost 5. Because all usage draws from the same pool, you can easily shift spend (e.g., from Email to Agent Console) without needing to contract a new product. Credits give you the flexibility to adapt your strategy as your customer needs change and your business strategy evolves.

mainEntity.name: How will I be able to track my usage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Braze has comprehensive reporting and billing dashboards to help you monitor performance throughout your contract.

mainEntity.name: What kind of support will I get?

acceptedAnswer.text: Braze offers a variety of Support and Service plans to fit customer needs including 24x7x365 Customer support for the world's leading brands. From initial implementation to long-term strategy, we deliver support and partnership, wherever you need it, when you need it. Check out our Support & Services to learn more: https://www.braze.com/customer-support-services

mainEntity.name: Does Braze offer a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Braze does not offer a free plan at this time. Companies can still explore the platform through trials, startup programs, and other tailored entry plans. Speak to your account manager or contact us for more details.

Braze for Success

We're committed to your journey and committed to your success. From bespoke onboarding and training programs to round-the-clock support, Braze is a fit-for-purpose partner designed to help guide your customer engagement evolution. From quick wins to long-term successes, bridge your technical and personnel gaps with proven expertise from a best-in-class solution.

Contact Sales

Jumpstart Your Journey

Create a customized team of technical and functional specialists to best meet your needs and support your goals. Accelerate deployments, reduce implementation costs, and connect with a community of knowledgeable peers in the field.

Integration and Onboarding Services

Long-term success starts with strong support and strategic onboarding. Our outcomes-oriented team will design a solution that matches your specific goals, getting you the just-right fit for your integration and implementation needs.

Learn More

Bonfire Community

When you buy Braze, you don't just gain access to technology. You gain access to an incredible community of data-driven marketers that will continuously inspire you with best practices, compelling use cases, and new ways to use Braze.

Learn More

Braze Platform

Our platform is designed for ease of use and is fit for purpose to solve today's customer engagement needs. Each of our add-on services provides incremental value to the teams that require different levels of strategic or technical support.

Learn More
"The help I received was not only clear and concise, but conversational and friendly as well! I am only a few weeks into using Braze in my role, but it has been a great experience from UX to Support."
Cecilia McGuinness
CRM Coordinator, AMC TV

Uplevel Your Teams

Leverage training programs and domain experts who will continuously educate, inspire, and challenge you to stay ahead of the market. Lean into customized services that assist with implementing new strategies and best practices so your team can get the most out of your customer engagement program.

Customer Success

Our multidisciplinary CSMs are committed to customer goals, sharing success against outcomes like adoption, advocacy, and retention. Our world-class success teams have won multiple awards, including the 2021 Customer Success Team of the Year.

Learn More

Email Deliverability

With decades of experience, our email experts can get your email program up-to-speed rapidly. Whether you need help with high-volume sends or ongoing deliverability monitoring, we're here to elevate your email strategy.

Learn More

Technical Account Management

Focused on technical strategy, we have designated liaisons who provide expertise to expand the usage of complex products and features. They also serve as the liaison between technical and marketing team members.

Learn More

Email Creative Services

Our full-service email creative agency can build campaigns and assets from the ground up or translate existing assets over to Braze.

Learn More

Braze Learning

Deepen your product knowledge and stay up-to-date with customer engagement best practices with on-demand courses and virtual instructor-led trainings. You can also show off your skills and advance your career with a Braze Certification.

Learn More
"She's [Erin] great at solving mysteries, digging in and identifying missing parts, leaving no stone unturned—and she does it all really fast. Having her as your CSM is like having a super power."
Erika Finnemore
Gerente de aquisição móvel, marketing de produto, Entercom

Ensure Your Success

Trust Braze to resolve critical questions, mitigate risks, and get to the bottom of technical issues quickly with access to 24/7/365 global support specialists. Our in-house team of employees are trained to triage and resolve issues at any time, on any day of the week with a focus on complete customer satisfaction.

Technical Support

With customer satisfaction as its main focus, our support team provides positive and memorable support interactions that do more than just resolve issues. We are a three-time recipient of the CRMI NorthFace ScoreBoard Award for World Class Customer Support.

Learn More

Customer Support Portal

Easily log a support case in one dedicated, central location. You can also view all existing support cases across your entire org to track progress or find answers before you even have to ask.

Learn More

Support Engagement Leads

Continuous access to a named support contact who will project manage all technical issues and inquires. They will work across Braze resources to provide regular and timely updates and next steps.

Learn More
"My questions are always answered, but Support goes further and offers alternative options and recommendations to simplify the process. I have several questions and queries a week and they are always answered so promptly that there is never any delay to my workflow at all, regardless of the size of the question."
Nate Duvel
Customer Relationship Management Manager, HeliosX Group
